name: Resolve Merge Conflicts By Intent
summary: Resolve Git conflicts by reconstructing both changes, preserving intent, and verifying the merged behavior.
description: Resolve an in-progress merge, rebase, or cherry-pick by tracing each side to its intent, selecting an explicit combined behavior, and verifying the resulting history. Use when conflict markers require semantic rather than mechanical resolution.
risk_reason: This skill resolves Git conflicts by reconstructing both changes, preserving intent, and verifying the merged behavior; it does not automatically abort, continue, commit, push, or force-update history.
refuses: It does not automatically abort, continue, commit, push, or force-update history.
It does not choose an entire side merely because it compiles or has the newer timestamp.
It does not rewrite unrelated files or hide verification failures inside conflict cleanup.

operational.latency_reason: The skill resolves Git conflicts by reconstructing both changes, preserving intent, and verifying the merged behavior, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
